findings.finding: Death-place example did not establish last domicile required for jurisdiction.
findings.correction: Example now states last domicile in Bern.

findings.finding: Commentary added a general urgency requirement to the indispensable-protection jurisdiction.
findings.correction: Tied analysis to statutory indispensability; removed general extra urgency condition.

findings.finding: Residence conditions and equal versus subsidiary forum alternatives needed clearer separation.
findings.correction: Explained consumer/provider alternatives and employee versus defendant residence conditions for recognition.

findings.finding: Creditor categories or Swiss-creditor shorthand could imply privilege-only participation or nationality.
findings.correction: Used Article 172(1) category reference and express domicile in Switzerland.

findings.finding: Distinct challenge periods and tribunal consent for evidence assistance needed unambiguous wording.
findings.correction: Specified separate 30 days from application and party acting with tribunal consent.

findings.finding: Crime-based revision explanation needed fuller procedural proof requirements.
findings.correction: Added separate criminal procedure, objective offence elements, alternative proof if unavailable, and actual influence on the disposition; checked full judgment 4A_528/2024 E. 5.1–5.3.

findings.finding: Age condition, objective applicable-law determination, sentence subject, oral establishment and asset description required precision.
findings.correction: Individual wording fixes, preserved substantive prose.

findings.finding: Duplicate chapter metadata keys caused chapters 3a/7a/9a to overwrite main book titles for 3/7/9.
findings.correction: Unique descriptors now combine both official chapter titles; regenerated index and chapters.

findings.finding: Four unnumbered preamble footnotes were retained only in raw sources, not separately accessible to book readers.
findings.correction: Parser now extracts preamble and independently assigns every one of 193 official footnotes; linked source appendix and register included.

findings.finding: Both cited judgments and all mapped claims checked against full text; no invented holding found.
findings.correction: Expanded cards with precise hearing exceptions and criminal-procedure proof limits; party allegations remain separate from court holdings.

limitations: Selective case-law coverage: two verified arbitration judgments; no exhaustive survey across all IPRG fields or all decisions published by the review date.

Referenced treaties, foreign substantive law and other statutes are not independently comprehensively commented; treaty membership, reservations and historical applicability require case-specific checking.
Consolidated annex II is an official ellipsis with historical publication reference; omitted historical amendments of other enactments are not reconstructed as current parallel statutory units.
This is an internal second-process manuscript review, not external professional approval or a guarantee of legal correctness.
Local links and selected primary official endpoints were checked; permanent availability of every external link was not exhaustively tested.
